series_start_reason: Pre-acquisition: Advanced Accelerator Applications (CIK 0001611787) never printed a Lutathera sales line; its Q3 2017 release (0000950103-17-011304, dp82822_ex9901.htm) prints only 'Therapeutic sales for the third quarter were EUR 5.4 million' (a category, EUR) and AAA, acquired January 2018, issued no Q4 2017 results. Novartis first prints Lutathera in Q1 2018 (via prior-year column).
moa: Somatostatin receptor-targeted radioligand therapy delivering lutetium-177

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 208700 NDA APPROVAL ... Lutathera (lutetium Lu 177 dotatate), injection for intravenous use

notes: launch_quarter 2017Q4: AAA Q3 2017 release (Nov 17, 2017): 'We are progressing with the commercial launch of lutetium Lu 177 dotatate (Lutathera) in Europe' after EU approval Sept 29, 2017; Novartis Q1 2018 report: 'launched in the US during Q1'. US approval Jan 2018 (AAA 6-K 0000950103-18-000895). 2018Q1 covers only post-acquisition days.
